faq.description: I've gathered the most common questions I receive. If your question isn't here, message me on WhatsApp and I'll be happy to answer!

items.question: Why combine nutrition and aesthetics?
items.answer: Real transformation happens from the inside out. When you balance your metabolic health through nutrition and enhance results with aesthetic procedures, the gains are faster, deeper and much longer-lasting. It's science working fully in your favor.

items.question: How long does it take to see results?
items.answer: This varies according to your goal and commitment. In general, changes in energy and disposition appear within the first 2-3 weeks. Visible weight-loss results begin in 4-6 weeks. For deep, lasting transformations, we recommend 3-6 month programs, where we closely monitor your progress and adjust strategies as needed.

items.question: Do I need to follow a very restrictive diet?
items.answer: No! My approach is exactly the opposite of fad diets. I work on dietary re-education and autonomy — you learn to make smart choices without suffering or going hungry. The goal is a healthy relationship with food, not extreme restriction. Done is better than perfect.

items.question: Do you see patients online or only in person?
items.answer: I offer both! In-person in Tijuca and Barra da Tijuca (Rio de Janeiro), and online anywhere in Brazil and abroad. Both have the same quality, dedication and results. The online consultation is via video call and you receive all material digitally.

items.question: What's the difference between regular and orthomolecular nutrition?
items.answer: Orthomolecular nutrition goes beyond basic diet — it works at the cellular level, identifying nutrient deficiencies and correcting them through food and/or compounded supplements. The focus is balancing your metabolism, optimizing energy, improving digestion and treating the root cause of symptoms — not just masking problems.

items.question: Are the aesthetic procedures safe?
items.answer: Absolutely. As an aesthetic biomedical professional, I have specific training in aesthetic procedures and use only high-quality products approved by ANVISA (Brazil's health regulatory agency). All protocols are personalized and performed with refined technique, always prioritizing your safety and natural results.

items.question: Can I do aesthetic procedures while dieting?
items.answer: Yes, and that's exactly the advantage of integration! When you're in a nutritionally guided weight-loss or muscle-gain process, aesthetic procedures enhance the results. For example: localized fat reduction + strategic nutrition = a faster, more complete transformation.

items.question: How does follow-up work? Do I have support between consultations?
items.answer: In the follow-up programs (quarterly and semiannual), you have monthly consultations for assessment and adjustments, plus support between consultations via WhatsApp for specific questions. The goal is for you to feel supported throughout the whole journey, not just during in-person visits.

items.question: Do you accept insurance or only private payment?
items.answer: Care is private-pay only. But I accept several payment methods: Pix (with a discount) and credit card in installments. Get in touch to learn about prices and personalized conditions for your case.

items.question: What age groups do you work with?
items.answer: I see teenagers (from age 16 with parental authorization), adults and seniors. Every stage of life has specific needs, and care is always personalized considering age, goals, routine and health history.

items.question: Can I book a consultation just to get to know the work?
items.answer: Of course! The initial consultation is already a complete assessment where we discuss your goals, history, routine and put together a personalized plan. It's the perfect opportunity for you to get to know me, ask questions and understand how I can help you. Many patients start this way and decide to continue with follow-up afterward.

items.question: What if I can't follow everything perfectly?
items.answer: That's completely normal and expected! Real life isn't Instagram. My job isn't to pressure you, but to understand you and adjust the plan to your reality. It won't be possible to follow it 100% every day, and that's okay. What matters is consistency, not perfection. The more you follow it, the better the results — but done is always better than perfect.
